text:
Priya: FYI Peridot Systems hit a blocker during their certed image import to their air-gapped registry. Marketplace image imports but our attestation agent can't reach attestation.redwood.ai and fails onboarding.
Jon: Can you paste the agent logs? Is it a DNS/egress block or something else?
Priya: Logs show an explicit timeout when contacting attestation service and then the agent exits with code 3. Snippet:
```
2025-02-12T09:03:10Z rwd-agent[1]: info: starting attestation
2025-02-12T09:03:10Z rwd-agent[1]: warn: attestation: can't reach https://attestation.redwood.ai:443 (timeout)
2025-02-12T09:03:11Z rwd-agent[1]: error: attestation: no response, fallback disabled
2025-02-12T09:03:11Z rwd-agent[1]: fatal: onboarding failed (exit 3)
```
Rui: If they're air-gapped we should support an offline attestation flow. Did Peridot import the SBOM/artifacts from the marketplace or did they pull our signed bundle and re-sign it?
Priya: They pulled the signed bundle, then their infra tool (private-reg-proxy) re-signed the image manifest with a local key during import. That breaks our attestation chain.
Taylor: Re-signing is a security issue for attestation; we need to decide whether to allow a 'proxy import' mode and record the customer's re-signing key in their trust bundle. Also PCI/FIPS customers may have strict rules.
Jon: For the short term can they skip attestation to continue staging? What are the risks? We need an enterprise-approved opt-out flow and an audit trail.
Rui: We have an internal hack: start the agent with `--attest-mode=offline --trusted-manifest=<path>` which bypasses remote verification if a signed manifest file is provided. That would unblock Peridot for now but requires eng-runtime + security sign-off.
Priya: Peridot wants a go-live next Tue. Can we run an architecture review with field-eng + runtime tomorrow 10am PT? They need a formal mitigation plan for the SOW.
deploy-bot: Ticket RWD-5129 created: `peridot-offline-attestation-triage` assigned to Rui, watchers: Priya, Taylor. https://rwd.atlassian.com/browse/RWD-5129
Taylor: I'll pre-review the offline attestation checklist and post the compliance caveats in the ticket. If we allow the workaround, we must add immutable audit logs and mark marketplace listing as 'requires-proxy-import' in metadata.
Jon: Also capture the import/re-sign step in the onboarding docs and add a note to marketplace requirements that customers must either preserve original signature or use approved import tooling.
Priya: Thanks. I'll confirm the meeting and ask Peridot to provide their import logs and the private-reg-proxy config. If we need to delay the joint announcement, we'll coordinate with marketing.
Jon: I'll draft a short holding note for marketing: "Announcing Peridot integration may be delayed pending verification of offline import and attestation in air-gapped environments." I'll share in #marketing after the arch call.
Rui: Prep action: I'll create a minimal repro and test `--attest-mode=offline` behavior, post results to RWD-5129 before the 10am call.
Priya: Great, meeting invite sent. See you all tomorrow.
